_meta.purpose: Sheets workplace app source-authority lock and PRD/source map before RED, Build, runtime, or implementation fanout. This artifact maps oya/sheets inventory/provenance into a bounded source map and records the evidence gates required before downstream work treats sheets artifacts as live readiness evidence.
